title: I regret this purchase four months in, and you will, too.
text: I regret this purchase four months in, and you will, too.. I really wanted to like these. I love the drama of them, the gold and the pitch black, and they’re proper heavy utensils. They feel and appear, at first, like they’re higher end. I treated them well and followed the recommended instructions for hand washing. They don’t stay in the sink and soak; they are dried with a towel and not by air; they don’t get thrown around after they’re cleaned, but stacked in their proper spot in the silverware drawer. But the black has been slowly rubbing off, showing gold underneath, and flaking to a point that I no longer feel ok using them. $60 USD down the drain basically.
